segments.name: Energy and digital infrastructure
segments.description: Mines bitcoin and develops AI inference and HPC capabilities across data centers in North America, the Middle East, Europe, and Latin America.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one operating segment and uses net income as a measure of profit or loss on a consolidated basis in making decisions regarding resource allocation and performance assessment.

revenueModel.text: The company earns newly issued bitcoin and transaction fees by validating blocks on the Bitcoin blockchain, and generates incremental income by lending and monetizing its bitcoin holdings.
revenueModel.evidence: The first miner to successfully validate a block through the network's proof-of-work consensus mechanism receives a reward in the form of newly issued bitcoin (block subsidy) and transaction fees associated with the validated transactions.

changes.text: In 2025, the company began selling bitcoin to fund operations rather than holding it solely as a long-term investment.
changes.evidence: In 2025, the Company began selling bitcoin to fund operations to enhance financial flexibility, and in 2026, the Company expects to continue to monetize bitcoin opportunistically to enhance our financial flexibility.
